Char­ac­ter

Talent Type

Category

Combat
Energy Cost Cool­down
60 15s
  • Info
Summons multiple Spirit BladesSpirit BladeA weapon with special power that Vesna can summon. Attacks the opponent alongside Vesna to deal Anemo DMG.
Vesna can summon Spirit Blades through the following ways:
  • By unleashing the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3;
  • By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!; or
  • By using Windborne Sword·: Transpose in the Constellation Unwavering Ardor.

Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt by the Spirit Blades become Anemo DMG that is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG instead., dealing AoE Anemo DMG. Also gains a stack of Sword EssenceSword EssenceThe energy required to use the special Elemental Skill Windborne Swordwhile in the Armed for Action mode.
Vesna can accumulate Sword Essence in the following ways:
  • By performing a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging attack while in the Armed for Action mode, or by unleashing Windborne Sword: Transpose from the Constellation Unwavering Ardor;
  • By using the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory; or
  • By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!
.

"First, always hold on tight to the sword in your hand; second, always present a neat and dignified appearance; and most important of all, always remain loyal to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa!"

For the Tsaritsa! is Vesna's Elemental Burst.
